capabilities: Render AsciiMath in inline and display math delimiters across Live Preview, Source, and Reading modes
Expand previously defined variables in later expressions using exp()
Define custom symbol-to-LaTeX mappings in the plugin settings
Highlight parts of an equation with highlight(...)
Convert AsciiMath expressions or whole notes to LaTeX via commands
extras: Manual installation via ZIP or building from source; requires Obsidian 1.9.10 or newer; mobile untested; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; notes with unconverted AsciiMath need the plugin installed to render.
intentEvidence: Write AsciiMath in Obsidian's standard $...$ expressions and $$...$$ blocks.
problem: Obsidian's native math delimiters expect LaTeX syntax, which is verbose and hard to read and write for everyday equations.
summary: AsciiMath renderer that lets users write readable math in Obsidian's native $...$ and $$...$$ delimiters, with LaTeX passthrough and conversion commands.
